title: Syrian Onion Flatbread
description: A traditional Syrian flatbread featuring caramelized onions and confit tomatoes, perfect for a light meal or snack, and carefully prepared to be onion and garlic friendly by using caramelized onions and no garlic at all.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the dough with olive oil and top with caramelized onions and confit tomatoes.
Bake the flatbreads in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the flatbreads from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
